scenes.sub: Being told what to do drains you faster than hard work.

scenes.text: You decide *fast*, and you're usually right.
scenes.sub: Others call it arrogance. It's the Sun in you.

scenes.text: Your luck *starts* the day you work for yourself.
scenes.sub: Mulank 1 earns best where its name is on the result.

scenes.caption: Ruled by the *Sun*. *Sunday* is your day.
